verses.en: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Yehudah and Benjamin; YAHUAH is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.am: አሳንም ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥ እንዲህም አለው። አሳ ይሁዳና ብንያም ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ እናንተ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስትሆኑ እርሱ ከእናንተ ጋር ነው፤ ብትፈልጉትም ይገኝላችኋል፤ ብትተዉት ግን ይተዋችኋል።

verses.en: Now for a long season Yisra'el hath been without the true YAHUAH, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ብዙ ዘመን ያለ እውነተኛ አምላክ፥ ያለ አስተማሪም ካህን፥ ያለ ሕግም ይኖሩ ነበር።

verses.en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto YAHUAH of Yisra'el, and sought him, he was found of them.
verses.am: በመከራቸውም ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመልሰው በፈለጉት ጊዜ አገኙት።

verses.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ለሚወጣውና ለሚገባው ሰላም አልነበረም፥ በምድርም በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ድንጋጤ ነበረ።

verses.en: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for YAHUAH did vex them with all adversity.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በመከራው ሁሉ ያስጨንቃቸው ነበርና ወገን ከወገን ጋር፥ ከተማም ከከተማ ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር።

verses.en: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ለሥራችሁ ብድራት ይሆንላችኋልና በርቱ፥ እጃችሁም አይላላ።

verses.en: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Yehudah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of YAHUAH, that was before the porch of YAHUAH.
verses.am: አሳም ይህን ቃልና የነቢዩን የዖዴድን ትንቢት በሰማ ጊዜ ልቡ ጸና፥ ከይሁዳና ከቢንያምም አገር ሁሉ በተራራማውም በኤፍሬም አገር ከያዛቸው ከተሞች ጸያፉን ነገር አስወገደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ፊት የነበረውን የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ አደሰ።

verses.en: And he gathered all Yehudah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Yisra'el in abundance, when they saw that YAHUAH his YAHUAH was with him.
verses.am: አምላኩም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር እንደ ሆነ ባዩ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተጠግተው ነበርና እርሱ ይሁዳንና ብንያምን ሁሉ፥ ከኤፍሬምና ከምናሴም ከስምዖንም መጥተው ከእነርሱ ጋር የተቀመጡትን ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: So they gathered themselves together at Yerushalayim in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.am: አሳም በነገሠ በአሥራ አምስተኛው ዓመት በሦስተኛው ወር በኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And they offered unto YAHUAH the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ካመጡት ምርኮ ሰባት መቶ በሬዎችና ሰባት ሺህ በጎች ለእግዚአብሔር ሠዉ።

verses.en: And they entered into a covenant to seek YAHUAH of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.am: በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ይሹ ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አደረጉ፤

verses.en: That whosoever would not seek YAHUAH of Yisra'el should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈልግ፥ ታናሽ ወይም ታላቅ፥ ወንድ ወይም ሴት ቢሆን፥ ይገደል ዘንድ ማሉ።

verses.en: And they sware unto YAHUAH with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም በታላቅ ድምፅና በእልልታ፥ በእምቢልታና በቀንደ መለከት ማሉ።

verses.en: And all Yehudah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and YAHUAH gave them rest round about.
verses.am: በፍጹምም ልባቸው ምለዋልና፥በፍጹምም ሕሊናቸው ፈልገውታልና፥ እርሱም ተገኝቶላቸዋልና ይሁዳ ሁሉ በመሐላው ደስ አላቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርም በዙሪያቸው ዕረፍት ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አሳ እናቱን መዓካን በማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ጣዖት ስላደረገች ከእቴጌነትዋ አዋረዳት፤ አሳም ምስልዋን ቈርጦ ቀጠቀጠው፥ በቄድሮንም ወንዝ አጠገብ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Yisra'el: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.am: በኮረብታ ላይ የነበሩትን መስገጃዎች ግን ከእስራኤል አላራቀም፤ ይሁን እንጂ የአሳ ልብ በዘመኑ ሁሉ ፍጹም ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought into the house of YAHUAH the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.am: አባቱም የቀደሰውን፥ እርሱም የቀደሰውን ወርቁንና ብሩን፥ ልዩ ልዩውንም ዕቃ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አገባ።

verses.en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.am: አሳም እስከ ነገሠበት እስከ ሠላሳ አምስተኛው ዓመት ድረስ ሰልፍ አልነበረም።

verses.en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Yisra'el came up against Yehudah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Yehudah.
verses.am: አሳ በነገሠ በሠላሳ ስድስተኛው ዓመት የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ባኦስ በይሁዳ ላይ ወጣ፥ ወደ ይሁዳም ንጉሥ ወደ አሳ ማንም መውጣትና መግባት እንዳይችል ራማን ሠራ።

verses.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of YAHUAH and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.am: አሳም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤትና ከንጉሡ ቤት መዝገብ ብርና ወርቅ ወስዶ።

verses.en: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Yisra'el, that he may depart from me.
verses.am: በአባቴና በአባትህ መካከል እንደ ነበረው ቃል ኪዳን በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ይሆናል፤ እነሆ ብርና ወርቅ ሰድጄልሃለሁ፤ እርሱ ከእኔ ዘንድ እንዲርቅ ሄደህ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከባኦስ ጋር ያለህን ቃል ኪዳን አፍርስ ብሎ በደማስቆ ወደተቀመጠው ወደ ሶሪያ ንጉሥ ወደ ወልደ አዴር ሰደደ።

verses.en: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Yisra'el; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
verses.am: ወልደ አዴር ንጉሡን አሳን እሺ አለው፥ የሠራዊቱም አለቆች በእስራኤል ከተሞች ላይ ሰደደ፤ እነርሱም ዒዮንንና ዳንን አቤልማይምንና የንፍታሌምን የዕቃ ቤት ከተሞች ሁሉ መቱ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
verses.am: ባኦስም በሰማ ጊዜ ራማን መሥራት ተወ፥ ሥራውንም አቋረጠ።

verses.en: Then Asa the king took all Yehudah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አሳ የይሁዳን ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፤ ባኦስ ይሠራበት የነበረውን የራማን ድንጋይና እንጨት አስወገዱ፥ እርሱም ጌባንና ምጽጳን ሠራበት።

verses.en: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Yehudah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ባለ ራእዩ አናኒ ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ አሳ መጥቶ እንዲህ አለው። በሶሪያ ንጉሥ ታምነሃልና፥ በአምላክህም በእግዚአብሔር አልታመንህምና ስለዚህ የሶሪያ ንጉሥ ጭፍራ ከእጅህ አምልጦአል።

verses.en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on YAHUAH, he delivered them into thine hand.
verses.am: ኢትዮጵያውያንና የልብያ ሰዎች እጅግ ብዙ ሰረገሎችና ፈረሰኞች የነበሩአቸው እጅግ ታላቅ ጭፍራ አልነበሩምን? በእግዚአብሔር ስለ ታመንህ በእጅህ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥

verses.en: For the eyes of YAHUAH run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ልቡ በእርሱ ዘንድ ፍጹም የሆነውን ያጸና ዘንድ ዓይኖቹ በምድር ሁሉ ይመለከታሉና። አሁንም ስንፍና አድርገሃል። ስለዚህም ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ሰልፍ ይሆንብሃል።

verses.en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
verses.am: አሳም በባለ ራእዩ ላይ ተቈጣ፤ ስለዚህም ነገር ተቈጥቶአልና በግዞት አኖረው፤ በዚያን ጊዜም አሳ ከሕዝቡ አያሌ ሰዎችን አስጨነቀ።

verses.en: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Yisra'el.
verses.am: የአሳም የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በይሁዳና በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to YAHUAH, but to the physicians.
verses.am: በነገሠም በሠላሳ ዘጠኝኛው ዓመት አሳ እግሩን ታመመ፤ ደዌውም ጸናበት፤ ነገር ግን በታመመ ጊዜ ባለ መድኃኒቶችን እንጂ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈለገም።

verses.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
verses.am: አሳም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በነገሠም በአርባ አንደኛው ዓመት ሞተ።

verses.en: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of Dawid, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.
verses.am: ለእርሱም ለራሱ በሠራው መቃብር በዳዊት ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ በቀማሚ ብልሃት የተሰናዳ ልዩ ልዩ መልካም ሽቱ በተሞላ አልጋ ላይም አኖሩት፤ እጅግም ታላቅ የሆነ የመቃብር ወግ አደረጉለት።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Yisra'el.
verses.am: በእርሱም ፋንታ ልጁ ኢዮሳፍጥ ነገሠ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ጠነከረ።

verses.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Yehudah, and set garrisons in the land of Yehudah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.am: በተመሸጉትም በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ወታደሮችን አኖረ፥ በይሁዳም አገር አባቱም አሳ በወሰዳቸው በኤፍሬም ከተሞች ዘበኞችን አስቀመጠ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father Dawid, and sought not unto Baalim;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከኢዮሳፍጥ ጋር ነበረ፥ በፊተኛይቱ በአባቱ በዳዊት መንገድ ሄዶአልና፥ በኣሊምንም አልፈለገምና፤

verses.en: But sought to YAHUAH of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የአባቱን አምላክ ፈለገ፥ በትእዛዙም ሄደ፥ የእስራኤልንም ሥራ አልሠራም።

verses.en: Therefore YAHUAH stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Yehudah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መንግሥቱን በእጁ አጸና፤ ይሁዳም ሁሉ እጅ መንሻ ለኢዮሳፍጥ አመጣ፤ እጅግም ብዙ ብልጥግናና ክብር ሆነለት።

verses.en: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of YAHUAH: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Yehudah.
verses.am: ልቡም በእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎችና የማምለኪያ ዐፀዱንም ከይሁዳ አስወገደ።

verses.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Benhail, and to Obadyah, and to Zekaryah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Yehudah.
verses.am: በነገሠም በሦስተኛው ዓመት በይሁዳ ከተሞች ያስተምሩ ዘንድ መሳፍንቱን፥ ቤንኃይልን፥ አብድያስን፥ ዘካርያስን፥ ናትናኤልን፥ ሚክያስን፥ ሰደደ።

verses.en: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ሌዋውያንን ሸማያን፥ ነታንያን፥ ዝባድያን፥ አሣሄልን፥ ሰሚራሞትን፥ ዮናትንን፥ አዶንያስን፥ ጦብያን፥ ጦባዶንያን ሰደደ ከእነርሱም ጋር ካህናቱን ኤሊሳማንና ኢዮራምን ሰደደ።

verses.en: And they taught in Yehudah, and had the book of the law of YAHUAH with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Yehudah, and taught the people.
verses.am: እነርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን የሕጉን መጽሐፍ ይዘው በይሁዳ ያስተምሩ ነበር፤ ወደ ይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ሄደው ሕዝቡን ያስተምሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And the fear of YAHUAH fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Yehudah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ዙሪያ በነበሩ መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ድንጋጤ ሆነ፥ ከኢዮሳፍጥም ጋር አልተዋጉም።

verses.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
verses.am: ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ለኢዮሳፍጥ እጅ መንሻና የብር ግብር ያመጡ ነበር፤ ዓረባውያንም ደግሞ ከመንጎቻቸው ሰባት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አውራ በጎችና ሰባት ሺህ ሰባት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አውራ ፍየሎች ያመጡለት ነበር።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Yehudah castles, and cities of store.
verses.am: ኢዮሳፍጥም እየበረታና እጅግም እየከበረ ሄደ፤ በይሁዳም ግንቦችንና የጎተራ ከተሞችን ሠራ።

verses.en: And he had much business in the cities of Yehudah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ከተሞች ብዙ ሥራ ሠራ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰልፈኞች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Yehudah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
verses.am: ቍጥራቸውም እንደ አባቶቻቸው ቤት ይህ ነበረ፤ ከይሁዳ ሻለቆች አለቃው ዓድና፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሦስት መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ አለቃው ይሆሐናን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት መቶ ሰማንያ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto YAHUAH; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ በፈቃዱ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር የቀደሰ የዝክሪ ልጅ ዓማስያ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
verses.am: ከብንያምም ጽኑዕ ኃያል የነበረው ኤሊዳሄ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ቀስትና ጋሻ የሚይዙ ሁለት መቶ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ዮዛባት፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ለሰልፍ የተዘጋጁ መቶ ሰማኒያ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Yehudah.
verses.am: ንጉሡ በተመሸጉ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ካኖራቸውም ሌላ እነዚህ ንጉሡን ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
verses.am: ለኢዮሣፍጥም ብዙ ብልጥግናና ክብር ነበረው፤ ለአክዓብም ጋብቻ ሆነ።

verses.en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramothgilead.
verses.am: ከጥቂት ዓመት በኋላም ወደ አክዓብ ወደ ሰማርያ ወረደ። አክዓብም ለእርሱና ከእርሱ ጋር ለነበሩት ሕዝብ ብዙ በጎችንና በሬዎችን አረደ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ይሄድ ዘንድ አባበለው።

verses.en: And Ahab king of Yisra'el said unto Jehoshaphat king of Yehudah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አክዓብ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ትሄዳለህን? አለው። እርሱም እኔ እንደ አንተ ነኝ፥ ሕዝቤም እንደ ሕዝብህ ናቸው፤ በሰልፍም ከአንተ ጋር እንሆናለን ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Yisra'el, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of YAHUAH to day.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አስቀድመህ ትጠይቅ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Therefore the king of Yisra'el gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for YAHUAH will deliver it into the king's hand.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ነቢያቱን አራት መቶ ሰዎች ሰብስቦ። ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ ልሂድን? ወይስ ልቅር? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እግዚአብሔር በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ውጣ አሉት።

verses.en: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of YAHUAH besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን። እንጠይቀው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ነቢይ የሆነ ሌላ ሰው በዚህ አይገኝምን? አለ።

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of YAHUAH: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። እግዚአብሔርን የምንጠይቅበት አንድ ሰው አለ፤ ነገር ግን ሁል ጊዜ ክፉ እንጂ ከቶ መልካም ትንቢት አይነግርልኝምና እጠላዋለሁ፤ እርሱም የይምላ ልጅ ሚክያስ ነው አለው። ኢዮሳፍጥም። ንጉሥ እንዲህ አይበል አለው።

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አንድ ጃንደረባ ጠርቶ። የይምላን ልጅ ሚክያስን ፈጥነህ አምጣው አለው።

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el and Jehoshaphat king of Yehudah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሳፍጥ ልብሰ መንግሥት ለብሰው በሰማሪያ በር መግቢያ አጠገብ በአደባባይ በዙፋኖቻቸው ላይ ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ነቢያትም ሁሉ በፊታቸው ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith YAHUAH, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
verses.am: የክንዓና ልጅ ሰዴቅያስም የብረት ቀንዶች ሠርቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሶሪያውያንን እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በእነዚህ ትወጋለህ አለ።

verses.en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for YAHUAH shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.am: ነቢያትም ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ሂድና ተከናወን እያሉ እንዲሁ ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
verses.am: ሚክያስንም ሊጠራ የሄደ መልእክተኛ። እነሆ፥ ነቢያት በአንድ አፍ ሆነው ለንጉሡ መልካም ይናገራሉ፤ ቃልህም እንደ ቃላቸው እንዲሆን መልካም እንድትናገር እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, As YAHUAH liveth, even what my YAHUAH saith, that will I speak.
verses.am: ሚክያስም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! አምላኬ የሚለውን እርሱን እናገራለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
verses.am: ወደ ንጉሡም በመጣ ጊዜ ንጉሡ። ሚክያስ ሆይ፥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ እንሂድን? ወይስ እንቅር? አለው። እርሱም። ውጣ፥ ተከናወን፤ በእጅህም አልፈው ይሰጣሉ አለ።

verses.en: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of YAHUAH?
verses.am: ንጉሡም። በእግዚአብሔር ስም ከእውነት በቀር እንዳትነግረኝ ስንት ጊዜ አምልሃለሁ? አለው።

verses.en: Then he said, I did see all Yisra'el scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and YAHUAH said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
verses.am: እርሱም። እስራኤል ሁሉ ጠባቂ እንደሌላቸው በጎች በተራሮች ላይ ተበትነው አየሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ለእነዚህ ጌታ የላቸውም፥ እያንዳንዱም በሰላም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ አለ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ክፉ እንጂ መልካም ትንቢት አይናገርልኝም አላልሁህምን? አለው።

verses.en: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of YAHUAH; I saw YAHUAH sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.am: ሚክያስም አለ። እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔር በዙፋኑ ተቀምጦ፥ የሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ በቀኙና በግራው ቆመው አየሁ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Yisra'el, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ወጥቶ በሬማት ዘገለዓድ ይወድቅ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ አክዓብን የሚያታልል ማን ነው? አለ። አንዱም እንደዚህ፥ ሌላውም እንደዚያ ያለ ነገር ተናገረ።

verses.en: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before YAHUAH, and said, I will entice him. And YAHUAH said unto him, Wherewith?
verses.am: መንፈስም መጣ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቆሞ። እኔ አታልለዋለሁ አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። በምን? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And YAHUAH said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.
verses.am: እርሱም። ወጥቼ በነቢያቱ ሁሉ አፍ ሐሰተኛ መንፈስ እሆናለሁ አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። ታታልለዋለህ፤ ይቀናሃል፤ ውጣ፥ እንዲህም አድርግ አለ።

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, YAHUAH hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and YAHUAH hath spoken evil against thee.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእነዚህ በነቢያትህ አፍ ሐሰተኛ መንፈስን አድርጎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በአንተ ላይ ክፉ ተናግሮብሃል።

verses.en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of YAHUAH from me to speak unto thee?
verses.am: የክንዓናም ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ ቀረበ፥ ሚክያስንም በጥፊ መታውና። የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ከአንተ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ በምን መንገድ ከእኔ አለፈ? አለ።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.am: ሚክያስም። እነሆ፥ በዚያ ቀን ልትሸሸግ ወደ እልፍኝህ ስትሄድ ታያለህ አለ።

verses.en: Then the king of Yisra'el said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ሚክያስን ውሰዱ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም አለቃ ወደ አሞን፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአስ መልሳችሁ።

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.
verses.am: ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል። በደኅና እስክመለስ ድረስ ይህን ሰው በግዞት አኑሩት፥ የመከራም እንጀራ መግቡት፥ የመከራም ውኃ አጠጡት በሉ አለ።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not YAHUAH spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.
verses.am: ሚክያስም። በደህና ብትመለስ እግዚአብሔር በእኔ የተናገረ አይደለም አለ። ደግሞም። እናንተ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ስሙኝ አለ።

verses.en: So the king of Yisra'el and Jehoshaphat the king of Yehudah went up to Ramothgilead.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ወጡ።

verses.en: And the king of Yisra'el said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Yisra'el disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥም ኢዮሣፍጥን። ልብሴን ለውጬ ወደ ሰልፍ እገባለሁ፤ አንተ ግን ልብስህን ልበስ አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ልብሱን ለወጠ፥ ወደ ሰልፍም ገቡ።

verses.en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Yisra'el.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች። ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ በቀር ትንሽ ቢሆን ወይም ትልቅ ከማናቸውም ጋር አትጋጠሙ ብሎ አዝዞ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Yisra'el. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and YAHUAH helped him; and YAHUAH moved them to depart from him.
verses.am: የሰረገሎችም አለቆች ኢዮሣፍጥን ባዩ ጊዜ። የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነው አሉ፥ ሊጋጠሙትም ከበቡት፤ ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን ጮኸ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ረዳው፥ አምላኩም ከእርሱ መለሳቸው።

verses.en: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Yisra'el, they turned back again from pursuing him.
verses.am: የሰረገሎቹም አለቆች የእስራኤል ንጉሥ እንዳልሆነ ባዩ ጊዜ እርሱን ከማሳደድ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Yisra'el between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.am: አንድ ሰውም ቀስቱን በድንገት ገትሮ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ በጥሩሩ መጋጠሚያ በኩል ሳምባውን ወጋው። ሰረጋለኛውንም። ተወግቻለሁና እጅህን ግታ ከሰልፍም ውስጥ አውጣኝ አለው።

verses.en: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Yisra'el stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሰልፍ በረታ፤ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በሶሪያውያን ፊት እስከ ማታ ድረስ በሰረገላው ላይ ራሱን ይደግፍ ነበር፤ ፀሐይም በገባ ጊዜ ሞተ።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Yehudah returned to his house in peace to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በደኅና ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate YAHUAH? therefore is wrath upon thee from before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ባለ ራእዩ የአናኒ ልጅ ኢዩ ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥ ንጉሡንም ኢዮሣፍጥን። ከሐዲውን ታግዛለህን? ወይስ እግዚአብሔርን የሚጠሉትን ትወድዳለህን? ስለዚህም ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ቍጣ ሆኖብሃል።

verses.en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹን ከምድር አስወግደሃልና፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ትፈልግ ዘንድ ልብህን አዘጋጅተሃልና መልካም ነገር ተገኝቶብሃል አለው።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Yerushalayim: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጠ፤ ደግሞም ከቤርሳቤህ ጀምሮ እስከ ተራራማው እስከ ኤፍሬም አገር ድረስ ወደ ሕዝቡ ወጥቶ ወደ አባቶቻቸው አምላክ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መለሳቸው።

verses.en: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Yehudah, city by city,
verses.am: በምድር ላይ በተመሸጉት በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ በእያንዳንዱ ከተማ ውስጥ ፈራጆች አኖረ።

verses.en: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for YAHUAH, who is with you in the judgment.
verses.am: ፈራጆቹንም። ለእግዚአብሔር እንጂ ለሰው አትፈርዱምና፥ እርሱም በፍርድ ነገር ከእናንተ ጋር ነውና የምታደርጉትን ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: Wherefore now let the fear of YAHUAH be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with YAHUAH our YAHUAH, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
verses.am: አሁንም እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በእናንተ ላይ ይሁን፤ በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በደልና ለሰው ፊት ማድላት መማለጃም መውሰድ የለምና ሁሉን ተጠንቅቃችሁ አድርጉ አላቸው።

verses.en: Moreover in Yerushalayim did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Yisra'el, for the judgment of YAHUAH, and for controversies, when they returned to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከሌዋውያንና ከካህናት ከእስራኤልም የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች፥ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ፍርድን እንዲፈርዱ ክርክርንም እንዲቈርጡ በኢየሩሳሌም ሾመ። እነርሱም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of YAHUAH, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብሎ አዘዛቸው። እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔርን በመፍራት በቅንነትም በፍጹምም ልብ አድርጉ።

verses.en: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against YAHUAH, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.
verses.am: በከተሞቻቸውም ከተቀመጡት ከወንድሞቻችሁ በደምና በደም መካከል በሕግና በትእዛዝ በሥርዓትና በፍርድም መካከል ያለ ማናቸውም ነገር ወደ እናንተ ቢመጣ እግዚአብሔርን እንዳይበድሉ፥ ቍጣም በእናንተና በወንድሞቻችሁ ላይ እንዳይመጣ አስጠንቅቁአቸው፤ እንዲህም ብታደርጉ በደለኞች አትሆኑም።

verses.en: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of YAHUAH; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Yehudah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and YAHUAH shall be with the good.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ለእግዚአብሔር በሚሆነው ነገር ሁሉ የካህናቱ አለቃ አማርያ፥ በንጉሡም ነገር ሁሉ የይሁዳ ቤት አለቃ የይስማኤል ልጅ ዝባድያ በላያችሁ ተሾመዋል፤ ሌዋውያኑም ደግሞ በፊታችሁ አለቆች ይሆናሉ፤ በርትታችሁም አድርጉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም መልካም ከሚያደርግ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከዚህ በኋላ የሞዓብና የአሞን ልጆች ከእነርሱም ጋር ምዑናውያን ኢዮሣፍጥን ሊወጉ መጡ።

verses.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazontamar, which is Engedi.
verses.am: ወሬኞችም መጥተው። ከባሕሩ ማዶ ከሶሪያ ታላቅ ሠራዊት መጥቶብሃል፤ እነሆም፥ ዓይንጋዲ በተባለች በሐሴሶን ታማር ናቸው ብለው ለኢዮሣፍጥ ነገሩት።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek YAHUAH, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Yehudah.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ፈራ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ሊፈልግ ፊቱን አቀና፤ በይሁዳም ሁሉ ጾም አወጀ።

verses.en: And Yehudah gathered themselves together, to ask help of YAHUAH: even out of all the cities of Yehudah they came to seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: ይሁዳም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልግ ዘንድ ተከማቸ፤ ከይሁዳ ከተሞችም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ መጡ።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, in the house of YAHUAH, before the new court,
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ጉባኤ መካከል በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በአዲሱ አደባባይ ፊት ቆመ፤

verses.en: And said, O YAHUAH of our fathers, art not thou YAHUAH in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። አቤቱ የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማይ ያለህ አምላክ አንተ አይደለህምን? የአሕዛብንስ መንግሥታት ሁሉ የምትገዛ አንተ አይደለህምን? ኃይልና ችሎታ በእጅህ ነው፥ ሊቋቋምህም የሚችል የለም።

verses.en: Art not thou our YAHUAH, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Yisra'el, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
verses.am: አምላካችን ሆይ፥ በዚህ ምድር የነበሩትን አሕዛብ ከሕዝብህ ከእስራኤል ፊት ያሳደድህ፥ ለወዳጅህም ለአብርሃም ዘር ለዘላለም የሰጠሃት አንተ አይደለህምን?

verses.en: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
verses.am: እነርሱም የተቀመጡባት፥ ለስምህም መቅደስን ሠርተውባት።

verses.en: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.
verses.am: ክፉ ነገር፥ የፍርድ ሰይፍ ወይም ቸነፈር ወይም ራብ፥ ቢመጣብን ስምህ ባለበት በዚህ ቤት ፊትና በፊትህ ቆመን በመከራችን ወደ አንተ እንጮኻለን፥ አንተም ሰምተህ ታድነናለህ አሉ።

verses.en: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Yisra'el invade, when they came out of the land of Mitsrayim, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እስራኤል ከግብጽ ምድር በወጡ ጊዜ ያልፉባቸው ዘንድ ያልፈቀድህላቸው፥ ነገር ግን ፈቀቅ ብለው ያላጠፉአቸው፥ የአሞንና የሞዓብ ልጆች የሴይርም ተራራ ሰዎች፥

verses.en: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለወሮታችን ክፋት ይመልሱልናል፤ ከሰጠኸንም ርስት ያወጡን ዘንድ መጥተዋል።

verses.en: O our YAHUAH, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
verses.am: አምላካችን ሆይ፥ አንተ አትፈርድባቸውምን? ይህን የመጣብንን ታላቅ ወገን እንቃወም ዘንድ አንችልም፤ የምናደርገውንም አናውቅም፤ ነገር ግን ዓይኖቻችን ወደ አንተ ናቸው።

verses.en: And all Yehudah stood before YAHUAH, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ሰዎች ሁሉ ከሕፃናቶቻቸውና ከሚስቶቻቸው ከልጆቻቸውም ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zekaryah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of YAHUAH in the midst of the congregation;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ ከአሳፍ ወገን በነበረው በሌዋዊው በማታንያ ልጅ በይዒኤል ልጅ በበናያስ ልጅ በዘካሪያስ ልጅ በየሕዚኤል ላይ በጉባኤው መካከል መጣ፤

verses.en: And he said, Hearken ye, all Yehudah, and ye inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith YAHUAH unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but YAHUAH's.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ይሁዳ ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ፥ አንተም ንጉሡ ኢዮሣፍጥ፥ ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላችኋል። ሰልፉ የእግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ የእናንተ አይደለምና ከዚህ ታላቅ ወገን የተነሣ አትፍሩ፥ አትደንግጡም።

verses.en: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.am: ነገ በእነርሱ ላይ ውረዱ፤ እነሆ፥ በጺጽ ዓቀበት ይወጣሉ፤ በሸለቆውም መጨረሻ በይሩኤል ምድረ በዳ ፊት ለፊት ታገኙአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of YAHUAH with you, O Yehudah and Yerushalayim: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for YAHUAH will be with you.
verses.am: እናንተ በዚህ ሰልፍ የምትዋጉ አይደላችሁም፤ ይሁዳና ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ተሰለፉ፥ ዝም ብላችሁ ቁሙ፥ የሚሆነውንም የእግዚአብሔርን መድኃኒት እዩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእናንተ ጋር ነውና አትፍሩ፥ አትደንግጡም፥ ነገም ውጡባቸው።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim fell before YAHUAH, worshipping YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም በምድር ላይ ተደፋ ይሁዳም ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደቁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ሰገዱ።

verses.en: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise YAHUAH of Yisra'el with a loud voice on high.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንም፥ የቀዓት ልጆችና የቆሬ ልጆች፥ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን በእጅግ ታላቅ ድምፅ ያመሰገኑት ዘንድ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Yehudah, and ye inhabitants of Yerushalayim; Believe in YAHUAH your YAHUAH, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
verses.am: ማልደውም ተነሡ፥ ወደ ቴቁሔም ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ ሲወጡም ኢዮሣፍጥ ቆመና። ይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር እመኑ፥ ትጸኑማላችሁ፤ በነቢያቱም እመኑ፥ ነገሩም ይሰላላችኋል አለ።

verses.en: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto YAHUAH, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise YAHUAH; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: ከሕዝቡም ጋር ተማክሮ በሠራዊቱ ፊት የሚሄዱትን። ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ የሚሉትንም፥ ጌጠኛ ልብስም ለብሰው የሚያመሰግኑትን፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚዘምሩትን መዘምራን አቆመ።

verses.en: And when they began to sing and to praise, YAHUAH set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Yehudah; and they were smitten.
verses.am: ዝማሬውንና ምስጋናውንም በጀመሩ ጊዜ ይሁዳን ሊወጉ በመጡት በአሞንና በሞዓብ ልጆች በሴይርም ተራራ ሰዎች ላይ እግዚአብሔር ድብቅ ጦርን አመጣባቸው፤ እነርሱም ተመቱ።

verses.en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
verses.am: የአሞንና የሞዓብ ልጆችም በሴይር ተራራ በሚኖሩት ላይ ፈጽመው ይገድሉአቸው ዘንድ ያጠፉአቸውም ዘንድ ተነሥተውባቸው ነበር፤ በሴይርም የሚኖሩትን ካጠፉ በኋላ እያንዳንዱ ባልንጀራውን ለማጥፋት ተረዳዳ።

verses.en: And when Yehudah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ሰዎች ወደ ምድረ በዳ ግንብ በመጡ ጊዜ ሕዝቡን አዩ፤ እነሆም፥ በምድሩ ሁሉ ሬሳ ሞልቶ ነበር፥ ያመለጠም ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥና ሕዝቡም ምርኮ ይወስዱ ዘንድ መጡ ብዙ ከብትና ልዩ ልዩ ዕቃም፥ ልብስም፥ እጅግም ያማረ ዕቃ አገኙ፥ በዘበዙትም፥ ሁሉንም ይሸከሙ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤ ከምርኮውም ብዛት የተነሣ እስከ ሦስት ቀን ድረስ ይበዘብዙ ነበር።

verses.en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed YAHUAH: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
verses.am: በአራተኛውም ቀን በበረከት ሸለቆ ውስጥ ተሰበሰቡ፥ በዚያም እግዚአብሔርን ባረኩ፤ ስለዚህም ያ ስፍራ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የበረከት ሸለቆ ተባለ።

verses.en: Then they returned, every man of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Yerushalayim with joy; for YAHUAH had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.am: የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች፥ በፊታቸውም ኢዮሣፍጥ፥ እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶቻቸው ላይ ደስ አሰኝቶአቸዋልና በደስታ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And they came to Yerushalayim with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በበገናም በመሰንቆም በመለከትም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ገቡ።

verses.en: And the fear of YAHUAH was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that YAHUAH fought against the enemies of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ጠላቶች እንደ ወጋ በሰሙ ጊዜ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርሃት ሆነ።

verses.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his YAHUAH gave him rest round about.
verses.am: የኢዮሣፍጥም መንግሥት ጸጥ አለች፥ አምላኩም በዙሪያው ካሉ አሳረፈው።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Yehudah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Yerushalayim. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ፤ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜም የሠላሳ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ አምስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የሺልሒ ልጅ ዓዙባ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በአባቱም በአሳ መንገድ ሄደ፥ ከእርሱም ፈቀቅ አላለም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን አደረገ።

verses.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የኮረብታው መስገጃዎች አልተወገዱም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና ልባቸውን ወደ አባቶቻቸው አምላክ አላዘጋጁም ነበር።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Yisra'el.
verses.am: የቀረውም የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው የኢዮሣፍጥ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ውስጥ በሚገኘው በአናኒ ልጅ በኢዩ ታሪክ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Yehudah join himself with Ahaziah king of Yisra'el, who did very wickedly:
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ሥራው እጅግ ክፉ ከሆነ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከአካዝያስ ጋር ተባበረ።

verses.en: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongeber.
verses.am: ወደ ተርሴስም የሚሄዱትን መርከቦች ያሠሩ ዘንድ አንድ ሆኑ፤ መርከቦቹንም በዔጽዮንጋብር አሠሩ።

verses.en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, YAHUAH hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.am: የመሪሳም ሰው የዶዳያ ልጅ አልዓዛር። ከአካዝያስ ጋር ተባብረሃልና እግዚአብሔር ሥራህን አፍርሶታል ብሎ በኢዮሣፍጥ ላይ ትንቢት ተናገረ። መርከቦቹም ተሰበሩ፥ ወደ ተርሴስም ይሄዱ ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ኢዮራም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zekaryah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ለእርሱም የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች ዓዛርያስ፥ ይሒኤል፥ ዘካርያስ፥ ዔዛርያስ፥ ሚካኤል፥ ሰፋጥያስ የሚባሉ ወንድሞች ነበሩት፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Yehudah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
verses.am: አባታቸውም ብዙ ስጦታ፥ ብርና ወርቅ፥ የከበረም ዕቃ፥ በይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ሰጣቸው፤ መንግሥቱን ግን በኵር ልጁ ስለ ሆነ ለኢዮራም ሰጠ።

verses.en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም በአባቱ መንግሥት ላይ ተነሥቶ በጸና ጊዜ ወንድሞቹን ሁሉ ሌሎችንም የእስራኤልን መሳፍንት በሰይፍ ገደለ።

verses.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Yisra'el, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of YAHUAH.
verses.am: የአክአብንም ልጅ አግብቶ ነበርና የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.en: Howbeit YAHUAH would not destroy the house of Dawid, because of the covenant that he had made with Dawid, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከዳዊት ጋር ስላደረገው ቃል ኪዳን፥ ለእርሱና ለልጆቹም በዘመናት ሁሉ መብራት ይሰጠው ዘንድ ስለ ሰጠው ተስፋ፥ እግዚአብሔር የዳዊትን ቤት ያጠፋ ዘንድ አልወደደም።

verses.en: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Yehudah, and made themselves a king.
verses.am: በእርሱም ዘመን ኤዶምያስ በይሁዳ ላይ ዐመፀ፥ ለራሱም ንጉሥ አነገሠ።

verses.en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም ከአለቆቹና ከሰረገሎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ተሻገረ፤ በሌሊትም ተነሥቶ እርሱንና የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች ከብበው የነበሩትን የኤዶምያስን ሰዎች መታ።

verses.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Yehudah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken YAHUAH of his fathers.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስ ግን በይሁዳ ላይ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ዐመፀ፥ በዚያንም ዘመን ልብና ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ዐመፀ፥ የአባቶቹን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትቶ ነበርና።

verses.en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Yehudah, and caused the inhabitants of Yerushalayim to commit fornication, and compelled Yehudah thereto.
verses.am: ዳግምም በይሁዳ ተራሮች ላይ መስገጃዎችን ሠራ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የተቀመጡትን እንዲያመነዝሩ አደረጋቸው፥ ይሁዳንም አሳተው።

verses.en: And there came a writing to him from Eliyahu the prophet, saying, Thus saith YAHUAH of Dawid thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Yehudah,
verses.am: ከነቢዩም ከኤልያስ እንዲህ የሚል ጽሕፈት መጣባት። የአባትህ የዳዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በአባትህ በኢዮሣፍጥ መንገድ በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ መንገድ አልሄድህምና፥

verses.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Yisra'el, and hast made Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:
verses.am: በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ግን ሄደሃልና፥ የአክዓብም ቤት እንዳደረገ ይሁዳንና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን እንዲያመነዝሩ አድርገሃልና፥ ከአንተም የሚሻሉትን የአባትህን ቤት ወንድሞችህን ገድለሃልና፥

verses.en: Behold, with a great plague will YAHUAH smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝብህንና ልጆችህን ሚስቶችህንም ያለህንም ሁሉ በታላቅ መቅሠፍት ይቀሥፋል።

verses.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
verses.am: አንተም ከደዌው ጽናት የተነሣ አንጀትህ በየዕለቱ እስኪወጣ ድረስ በክፉ የአንጀት ደዌ ትታመማለህ።

verses.en: Moreover YAHUAH stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የፍልስጥኤማውያንና በኢትዮጵያውያን አጠገብ የሚኖሩትን የዓረባውያንን መንፈስ በኢዮራም ላይ አስነሣ።

verses.en: And they came up into Yehudah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
verses.am: ወደ ይሁዳም ወጡ፥ አፈረሱአትም፥ የንጉሡንም ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ ወንዶች ልጆቹንም ሴቶች ልጆቹንም ማረኩ፤ ከታናሹም ልጅ ከአካዝያስ በቀር ልጅ አልቀረለትም።

verses.en: And after all this YAHUAH smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
verses.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር በማይፈወስ ደዌ አንጀቱን ቀሰፈው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
verses.am: ከቀንም ወደ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከሁለት ዓመት በኋላ ከደዌው ጽናት የተነሣ አንጀቱ ወጣ፥ በክፉም ደዌ ሞተ። ሕዝቡም ለአባቶቹ ያደርገው እንደ ነበር ለእርሱ የመቃብር ወግ አላደረገም።

verses.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Yerushalayim eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of Dawid, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.am: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ ማንም ሳያዝንለት ሄደ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ እንጂ በነገሥታት መቃብር አልቀበሩትም።

verses.en: And the inhabitants of Yerushalayim made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yehudah reigned.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም የነበሩትም ታናሹን ልጁን አካዝያስን በእርሱ ፋንታ አነገሡት። የመጣባቸው የዓረብና የአሊማዞን የሽፍቶች ጭፍራ የእርሱን ታላቆች ገድለዋቸው ነበርና። የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮራም ልጅ አካዝያስ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
verses.am: አካዝያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ ዕድሜው አርባ ሁለት ዓመት ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ጎቶሊያ የተባለች የዘንበሪ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
verses.am: እናቱም ክፉ ለማድረግ ትመክረው ነበርና እርሱ ደግሞ በአክዓብ ቤት መንገድ ሄደ።

verses.en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of YAHUAH like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
verses.am: አባቱም ከሞተ በኋላ የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ መካሪዎች ነበሩትና።

verses.en: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Yisra'el to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
verses.am: በምክራቸውም ሄደ፥ ከእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ከአክዓብ ልጅ ከኢዮራም ጋር የሶርያን ንጉሥ አዛሄልን በሬማት ዘገለአድ ሊዋጋ ሄደ፤ ሶርያውያንም ኢዮራንም አቈሰሉት።

verses.en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Yehudah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.am: ከሶርያም ንጉሥ ከአዛሄል ጋር በተዋጋ ጊዜ ሶርያውያን በሬማት ያቈሰሉትን ቍስል ይታከም ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ተመለሰ፤ ታምሞም ነበርና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮራም ልጅ አካዝያስ የአክዓብን ልጅ ኢዮራምን ያይ ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ወረደ።

verses.en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of YAHUAH by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom YAHUAH had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
verses.am: አካዝያስም ወደ ኢዮራም በመምጣቱ ይጠፋ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ነበረ፤ በመጣም ጊዜ ከኢዮራም ጋር እግዚአብሔር የአክዓብን ቤት ያጠፋ ዘንድ ወደ ቀባው ወደ ናሜሲ ልጅ ወደ ኢዩ ወጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Yehudah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
verses.am: ኢዩም በአክዓብ ቤት ላይ ፍርድን ሲፈጽም የይሁዳን መሳፍንትና አካዝያስን ያገለግሉ የነበሩትን የአካዝያስን ወንድሞች ልጆች አግኝቶ ገደላቸው።

verses.en: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought YAHUAH with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
verses.am: አካዝያስንም ፈለገው፥ በሰማርያ ተሸሽጎ ሳለ አገኙት፤ ወደ ኢዩም አምጥተው ገደሉትና። በፍጹም ልብ እግዚአብሔርን የፈለገው የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጅ ነው ብለው ቀበሩት። ከአካዝያስም ቤት ማንም መንግሥትን ይይዝ ዘንድ የሚችል አልነበረም።

verses.en: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Yehudah.
verses.am: የአካዝያስም እናት ጎቶሊያ ልጅዋ እንደ ሞተ ባየች ጊዜ ተነሥታ የይሁዳን ቤተ መንግሥት ዘር ሁሉ አጠፋች።

verses.en: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
verses.am: የንጉሡ ልጅ ዮሳቤት ግን ከተገደሉት ከንጉሡ ልጆች መካከል የአካዝያስን ልጅ ኢዮአስን ሰርቃ ወሰደች፤ እርሱንና ሞግዚቱን በእልፍኝ ውስጥ አኖረቻቸው፤ ጎቶሊያ እንዳታስገድለው የንጉሡ የኢዮራም ልጅ የአካዛያስ እኅት የካህኑ የዮዳሄ ሚስት ዮሳቤት እንዲሁ ሸሸገችው።

verses.en: And he was with them hid in the house of YAHUAH six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.am: በእነርሱም ዘንድ ተሸሽጎ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ስድስት ዓመት ያህል ተቀመጠ፤ ጎቶልያም በምድር ላይ ነገሠች።

verses.en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ዓመት ዮዳሄ በረታ፥ የመቶ አለቆቹንም፥ የይሮሐምን ልጅ ዓዛርያስን፥ የይሆሐናንንም ልጅ ይስማኤልን፥ የዖቤድንም ልጅ ዓዛርያስን፥ የዓዳያንም ልጅ መዕሤያን፥ የዝክሪንም ልጅ ኤሊሳፋጥን ወስዶ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: And they went about in Yehudah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Yehudah, and the chief of the fathers of Yisra'el, and they came to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ይሁዳንም ዞሩ፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ሌዋውያንንና የእስራኤልን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ሰብስበው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of YAHUAH. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as YAHUAH hath said of the sons of Dawid.
verses.am: ጉባኤውም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ከንጉሥ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ። ዮዳሄም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ዳዊት ልጆች እንደተናገረ የንጉሡ ልጅ ይነግሣል።

verses.en: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;
verses.am: የምታደርጉት ይህ ነው፤ በሰንበት ቀን ከምትገቡት ከእናንተ ከካህናትና ከሌዋዊውያን ከሦስት አንድ እጅ በመግቢያ በሮች በረኞች ሁኑ፤

verses.en: And a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከሦስት አንድ እጅም በንጉሥ ቤት ሁኑ፤ አንድ እጅም በመካከለኛው በር ሁኑ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: But let none come into the house of YAHUAH, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ግን ከካህናትና ከአገልጋዮቹ ሌዋውያን በቀር ማንም አይግባ፤ እነርሱ ቅዱሳን ናቸውና ይግቡ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ይጠብቅ።

verses.en: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንም የጦር መሣሪያቸውን በእጃቸው ይዘው ንጉሡን በዙሪያው ይክበቡት፤ ወደ ቤቱም የሚገባ ይገደል ንጉሡም ሲገባና ሲወጣ ከእርሱ ጋር ሁኑ።

verses.en: So the Levites and all Yehudah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንና ይሁዳም ሁሉ ካህኑ ዮዳሄ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ፤ ካህኑም ዮዳሄ ሰሞነኞቹን አላሰናበተም ነበርና እያንዳንዱ በሰንበት ቀን ይገቡ የነበሩትን በሰንበትም ቀን ይወጡ የነበሩትን ሰዎች ወሰደ።

verses.en: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king Dawid's, which were in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ካህኑም ዮዳሄ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን የንጉሡን የዳዊትን ጋሻና ጦር አላባሽ አግሬውንም ጋሻ ለመቶ አለቆች ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ የጦር መሣሪያውን በእጁ እየያዘ በንጉሡ ዙሪያ ከቤቱ ቀኝ እስከ ቤቱ ግራ ድረስ በመሠዊያውና በቤቱ አጠገብ እንዲቆም አደረገ።

verses.en: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, YAHUAH save the king.
verses.am: የንጉሡንም ልጅ አውጥተው ዘውዱን ጫኑበት፥ ምስክሩንም ሰጡት፥ አነገሡትም፤ ዮዳሄና ልጆቹም። ንጉሡ ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ እያሉ ቀቡት።

verses.en: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of YAHUAH:
verses.am: ጎቶሊያም የሚሮጡትንና ንጉሡን የሚያመሰግኑትን የሕዝቡን ድምፅ በሰማች ጊዜ ወደ ሕዝቡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት መጣች።

verses.en: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ንጉሡ በመግቢያው በዓምዱ አጠገብ ሆኖ ከንጉሡ ጋር አለቆችና መለከተኞች ቆመው አየች። የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደስ ብሎአቸው መለከቱን ይነፉ ነበር፤ መዘምራንም በዜማ ዕቃ እያዜሙ የምስጋና መዝሙር ይዘምሩ ነበር። ጎቶሊያም ልብስዋን ቀድዳ። ዓመፅ ነው፥ ዓመፅ ነው ብላ ጮኸች።

verses.en: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ካህኑም ዮዳሄ በጭፍራው ላይ የተሾሙትን የመቶ አለቆች። ወደ ሰልፉ መካከል አውጡአት፤ የሚከተላትም በሰይፍ ይገደል ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ካህኑም። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ አትግደሉአት አለ።

verses.en: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.
verses.am: ገለልም ብለው አሳለፉአት፤ እርስዋም ወደ ፈረሱ በር መግቢያ ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት ሄደች፥ በዚያም ገደሉአት።

verses.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be YAHUAH's people.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም በእርሱና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ በንጉሡም መካከል የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ በኣል ቤት ሄደው አፈረሱት፥ መሠዊያዎቹንና ምስሎቹንም አደቀቁ፥ የበኣልንም ካህን ማታንን በመሠዊያው ፊት ገደሉት።

verses.en: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of YAHUAH by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom Dawid had distributed in the house of YAHUAH, to offer the burnt offerings of YAHUAH, as it is written in the law of Mosheh, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by Dawid.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈው፥ እንደ ዳዊትም ትእዛዝ፥ በደስታና በመዝሙር ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የከፈላቸውን ካህናትና ሌዋውያን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ላይ ሾመ።

verses.en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of YAHUAH, that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.
verses.am: በማናቸውም ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ የሆነ ሰው እንዳይገባ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር በረኞችን አኖረ።

verses.en: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of YAHUAH: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቆችንም፥ ከበርቴዎቹንም፥ የሕዝቡንም አለቆች፥ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ ንጉሡንም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት አወረደ፤ በላይኛውም በር በኩል ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት መጡ፥ ንጉሡንም በመንግሥቱ ዙፋን ላይ አኖሩት።

verses.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
verses.am: የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደስ አላቸው፥ ከተማይቱም ጸጥ አለች፤ ጎቶሊያንም በሰይፍ ገደሉአት። ች

verses.en: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.am: ኢዮአስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሰባት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ሳብያ የተባለች የቤርሳቤህ ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.am: በካህኑም በዮዳሄ ዘመን ሁሉ ኢዮአስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም ሁለት ሚስቶች አጋባው፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢዮአስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይጠግን ዘንድ አሰበ።

verses.en: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Yehudah, and gather of all Yisra'el money to repair the house of your YAHUAH from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
verses.am: ካህናትንና ሌዋውያንንም ሰብስቦ። ወደ ይሁዳ ከተሞች ውጡ፥ የአምላካችሁንም ቤት በየዓመቱ ለማደስ ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ገንዘብን ሰብስቡ፤ ነገሩንም ፈጥናችሁ አድርጉ አላቸው። ሌዋውያን ግን ቸል አሉ።

verses.en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Yehudah and out of Yerushalayim the collection, according to the commandment of Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH, and of the congregation of Yisra'el, for the tabernacle of witness?
verses.am: ንጉሡም አለቃውን ዮዳሄን ጠርቶ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ስለ ምስክሩ ድንኳን የእስራኤል ጉባኤ እንዲያዋጣ ያዘዘውን ግብር ከይሁዳና ከኢየሩሳሌም ያመጡ ዘንድ ስለ ምን ሌዋውያንን አላተጋሃቸውም? አለው።

verses.en: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of YAHUAH; and also all the dedicated things of the house of YAHUAH did they bestow upon Baalim.
verses.am: ጎቶሊያ ከሐዲት ነበረችና ልጆችዋም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አፍርሰዋልና፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ተቀድሶ የነበረውን ሁሉ ለበኣሊም ሰጥተዋልና።

verses.en: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አዘዘ፥ ሣጥንም ሠርተው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር አጠገብ በስተ ውጭ አኖሩት።

verses.en: And they made a proclamation through Yehudah and Yerushalayim, to bring in to YAHUAH the collection that Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH laid upon Yisra'el in the wilderness.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ ሙሴ በምድረ በዳ በእስራኤል ላይ ያዘዘውን ግብር ለእግዚአብሔር ያመጡ ዘንድ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም አዋጅ ነገሩ።

verses.en: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
verses.am: አለቆቹና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ደስ ብሎአቸው አቀረቡት፥ እስኪሞላም ድረስ በሣጥኑ ውስጥ ጣሉት።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
verses.am: ሣጥኑም በሌዋውያን እጅ ወደ ንጉሡ ሹማምት በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ ብዙ ገንዘብም እንዳለበት ባየ ጊዜ፥ የንጉሡ ጸሐፊና የዋነኛው ካህን ሹም እየመጡ ብሩን ከሣጥን ያወጡ ነበር፥ ሣጥኑንም ደግሞ ወደ ስፍራው ይመልሱት ነበር። እንዲሁም በየቀኑ ያደርጉ ነበር፥ ብዙም ገንዘብ አከማቹ።

verses.en: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of YAHUAH, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of YAHUAH, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ንጉሡና ዮዳሄም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ሥራ ላይ ለተሾሙት ሰጡአቸው፤ እነርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት የሚጠግኑትን ጠራቢዎችንና አናጢዎችን፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት የሚያድሱትን የብረትና የናስ ሠራተኞችን ይገዙበት ነበር።

verses.en: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of YAHUAH in his state, and strengthened it.
verses.am: ሠራተኞችም ሠሩ፥ የፈረሰውም በእጃቸው ተጠገነ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት እንደ ቀድሞው ሥራ መለሱ፥ አጽንተውም አቆሙት።

verses.en: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of YAHUAH, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of YAHUAH continually all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.am: በጨረሱም ጊዜ የተረፈውን ገንዘብ በንጉሡና በዮዳሄ ፊት አመጡ፤ እነርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ፥ ለአገልግሎትና ለቍርባን ዕቃ፥ ለጭልፋዎችም፥ ለወርቅና ለብርም ዕቃ አደረጉት። በዮዳሄም ዘመን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሁልጊዜ ያቀርቡ ነበር።

verses.en: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም ሸመገለ፥ ዕድሜም ጠግቦ ሞተ፤ በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ነበረ።

verses.en: And they buried him in the city of Dawid among the kings, because he had done good in Yisra'el, both toward YAHUAH, and toward his house.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ጋር፥ ከእግዚአብሔርና ከቤቱም ጋር ቸርነትን ሠርቶአልና በዳዊት ከተማ ከነገሥታቱ ጋር ቀበሩት።

verses.en: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Yehudah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም ከሞተ በኋላ የይሁዳ አለቆች ገብተው ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሡ፤ ንጉሡም እሺ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they left the house of YAHUAH of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Yehudah and Yerushalayim for this their trespass.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችንና ጣዖታትን አመለኩ፤ በዚህ በደላቸውም ምክንያት በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ቍጣ ወረደ።

verses.en: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto YAHUAH; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመልሱአቸው ዘንድ ነቢያትን ይሰድድላቸው ነበር፤ መሰከሩባቸውም፥ እነርሱ ግን አላደመጡም።

verses.en: And the Spirit of YAHUAH came upon Zekaryah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith YAHUAH, Why transgress ye the commandments of YAHUAH, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken YAHUAH, he hath also forsaken you.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ልጅ በዘካርያስ ላይ መጣ፤ እርሱም በሕዝቡ ፊት ቆመና። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ለምን ትተላለፋላችሁ? መልካምም አይሆንላችሁም፤ እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ተዋችሁ እርሱ ትቶአችኋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ተማማሉበትም በንጉሡም ትእዛዝ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ውስጥ በድንጋይ ወገሩት።

verses.en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, YAHUAH look upon it, and require it.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ንጉሡ ኢዮአስ ዮዳሄ ያደረገለትን ቸርነት አላሰበም፥ ልጁንም ዘካርያስን አስገደለው፤ እርሱም ሲሞት። እግዚአብሔር ይየው፥ ይፈልገውም አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
verses.am: ዓመቱም ካለፈ በኋላ የሶርያውያን ሠራዊት መጡበት፤ ወደ ይሁዳና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጥተው ከሕዝቡ መካከል የሕዝቡን አለቆች ሁሉ አጠፉ፥ ምርኮአቸውንም ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ደማስቆ ላኩ።

verses.en: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and YAHUAH delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken YAHUAH of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
verses.am: የሶርያውያንም ሠራዊት ቍጥር ጥቂት ሆኖ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅን ሠራዊት አሳልፎ በእጃቸው ሰጣቸው፤ ይህም የሆነው የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ስለ ነበረ ነው። እነርሱም በኢዮአስ ላይ ፍርድ ፈረዱበት።

verses.en: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of Dawid, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ዘንድ አልፈው ከሄዱ በኋላ እጅግ ታምሞ ነበር፤ የገዛ ባሪያዎቹም ስለ ካህኑ ስለ ዮዳሄ ልጅ ተበቅለው ተማማሉበት፥ በአልጋውም ላይ ገደሉት፥ ሞተም፤ በዳዊት ከተማ እንጂ በነገሥታት መቃብር አልቀበሩትም።

verses.en: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
verses.am: የተማማሉበትም የአሞናዊቱ የሰምዓት ልጅ ዛባድ፥ የሞዓባዊቱም የሰማሪት ልጅ ዮዛባት ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of YAHUAH, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: የልጆቹና በእርሱ ላይ የተደረገው ነገር የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ማደሱ፥ እነሆ፥ በነገሥታቱ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል። ልጁም አሜስያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Yerushalayim. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: አሜስያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱ ዮዓዳን የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, but not with a perfect heart.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፥ ነገር ግን በፍጹም ልብ አይደለም።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
verses.am: መንግሥትም በጸናለት ጊዜ አባቱን የገደሉትን ባሪያዎች ገደለ።

verses.en: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Mosheh, where YAHUAH commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
verses.am: በሙሴም ሕግ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። ሰው ሁሉ በገዛ ኃጢያቱ ይሙት እንጂ አባቶች በልጆች ፋንታ አይሙቱ፥ ልጆችም በአባቶች ፋንታ አይሙቱ ብሎ እንዳዘዘ የነፍሰ ገዳዮችን ልጆች አልገደለም።

verses.en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Yehudah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Yehudah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
verses.am: አሜስያስም ይሁዳን ሰበሰበ፥ በእየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ከሺህ አለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች እጅ በታች አቆማቸው፤ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀመሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉትን ይሁዳንና ብንያምን ሁሉ ቈጠረ፥ ለሰልፍም የሚወጡ፥ ጋሻና ጦርም የሚይዙ ሦስት መቶ ሺህ የተመረጡ ሰዎች አገኘ።

verses.en: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Yisra'el for an hundred talents of silver.
verses.am: ደግሞም ከእስራኤል ዘንድ መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን በመቶ መክሊት ብር ቀጠረ።

verses.en: But there came a man of YAHUAH to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Yisra'el go with thee; for YAHUAH is not with Yisra'el, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
verses.am: አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ግን ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤልና ከኤፍሬም ልጆች ጋር አይደለምና የእስራኤል ጭፍራ ከአንተ ጋር አይውጣ።

verses.en: But if thou wilt go, do it, be strong for the battle: YAHUAH shall make thee fall before the enemy: for YAHUAH hath power to help, and to cast down.
verses.am: ብትሄድ ግን፥ በእነርሱም ማሸነፍን ብታስብ፥ የመርዳትና የመጣል ኃይል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነውና እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶችህ ፊት ይጥልሃል አለው።

verses.en: And Amaziah said to the man of YAHUAH, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Yisra'el? And the man of YAHUAH answered, YAHUAH is able to give thee much more than this.
verses.am: አሜስያስም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው። ለእስራኤል ጭፍራ የሰጠሁት መቶ መክሊት ምን ይሁን? አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። ከዚህ አብልጦ ይሰጥህ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይችላል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Yehudah, and they returned home in great anger.
verses.am: አሜስያስም ከኤፍሬም የመጡት ጭፍሮች ወደ ስፍራቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ ለይቶ አሰናበታቸው፤ ስለዚህም ቍጣቸው በይሁዳ ላይ ጸና፥ ወደ አገራቸውም በጽኑ ቍጣ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
verses.am: አሜስያስም በረታ፥ ሕዝቡንም አውጥቶ ወደ ጨው ሸለቆ ሄደ፥ ከሴይርም ልጆች አሥር ሺህ ገደለ።

verses.en: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Yehudah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ልጆች ደግሞ አሥር ሺህ ሰዎችን በሕይወታቸው ማረኩ፥ ወደ ዓለቱም ራስ ላይ አመጡአቸው፤ ከዓለቱም ራስ ላይ ጣሉአቸው፥ ሁሉም ተፈጠፈጡ።

verses.en: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Yehudah, from Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
verses.am: አሜስያስ ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ እንዳይሄዱ ያሰናበታቸው ጭፍሮች ከሰማርያ ጀምረው እስከ ቤትሖሮን ድረስ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ላይ አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ከእነርሱም ሦስት ሺህ ገደሉ፥ ብዙ ምርኮም ማረኩ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the elohim of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his elohim, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
verses.am: አሜስያስም የኤዶምያስን ሰዎች ከገደለ በኋላ የሴይርን ልጆች አማልክት አመጣ፥ የእርሱም አማልክት ይሆኑ ዘንድ አቆማቸው፥ ይሰግድላቸውም ያጥንላቸውም ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore the anger of YAHUAH was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the elohim of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
verses.am: ስለዚህም የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በአሜስያስ ላይ ነደደና። ሕዝባቸውን ከአንተ እጅ ያላዳኑትን የአሕዛብን አማልክት ስለ ምን ፈለግሃቸው? የሚል ነቢይ ሰደደበት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that YAHUAH hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
verses.am: እርሱም ሲናገር ንጉሡ። በውኑ አንተ የንጉሡ አማካሪ ልትሆን ሾመነሃልን? ተው፤ ቅጣትን ስለ ምን ትሻለህ? አለው። ነቢዩም። ይህን አድርገሃልና፥ ምክሬንም አልሰማህምና እግዚአብሔር ሊያጠፋህ እንዳሰበ አወቅሁ ብሎ ተወ።

verses.en: Then Amaziah king of Yehudah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Yisra'el, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ አሜስያስ ምክር አደረገና። ና፥ እርስ በርሳችን ፊት ለፊት እንተያይ ብሎ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወደ ኢዩ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአስ ላከ።

verses.en: And Joash king of Yisra'el sent to Amaziah king of Yehudah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮስያስ። የሊባኖስ ኵርንችት። ልጅህን ለልጄ ሚስት አድርገህ ስጠው ብሎ ወድ ሊባኖስ ዝግባ ላከ፤ የሊባኖስም አውሬ አልፎ ኵርንችቱን ረገጠ።

verses.en: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Yehudah with thee?
verses.am: አንተም። እነሆ፥ ኤዶምያስን መትቻለሁ ብለህ ኰርተሃል፤ በቤትህ ተቀመጥ፤ አንተ ከይሁዳ ጋር ትወድቅ ዘንድ ስለ ምን መከራ ትሻላህ? ብሎ ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ አሜስያስ ላከ።

verses.en: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of YAHUAH, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the elohim of Edom.
verses.am: የኤዶምያስንም አማልክት ስለ ፈለጉ በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ነበረና አሜስያስ አልሰማም።

verses.en: So Joash the king of Yisra'el went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Yehudah, at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Yehudah.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮአስ ወጣ፤ እርሱና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አሜስያስም በይሁዳ ባለች በቤትሳሚስ ላይ እርስ በርሳቸው ተያዩ።

verses.en: And Yehudah was put to the worse before Yisra'el, and they fled every man to his tent.
verses.am: ይሁዳም በእስራኤል ፊት ተመታ፥ እያንዳንዱም ወደ ድንኳኑ ሸሸ።

verses.en: And Joash the king of Yisra'el took Amaziah king of Yehudah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought him to Yerushalayim, and brake down the wall of Yerushalayim from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮአስ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የአካዝያስን ልጅ የኢዮአስን ልጅ አሜስያስን በቤትሳሚስ ይዞ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አመጣው፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር ከኤፍሬም በር ጀምሮ እስከ ማዕዘኑ በር ድረስ አራት መቶ ክንድ አፈረሰ።

verses.en: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of YAHUAH with Obededom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
verses.am: ወርቁንና ብሩን ሁሉ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ከዖቤድኤዶም ጋር የነበሩትን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ፥ የንጉሡን ቤት መዛግብት፥ በመያዣ የተያዙትንም ወስዶ ወደ ሰማርያ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yehudah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Yisra'el fifteen years.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ የኢዮአስ ልጅ አሜስያስ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ከኢዮአስ ሞት በኋላ አሥራ አምስት ዓመት ኖረ።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Yisra'el?
verses.am: የቀረውም የፊተኛውና የኋላኛው የአሜስያስ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በይሁዳና በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following YAHUAH they made a conspiracy against him in Yerushalayim; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
verses.am: አሜስያስም እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ከራቀ በኋላ በኢየሩሳሌም የዓመፅ መሐላ አደረጉበት፥ ወደ ለኪሶም ኰበለለ፤ በስተ ኋላውም ወደ ለኪሶ ላኩ፥ በዚያም ገደሉት።

verses.en: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Yehudah.
verses.am: በፈረስም ጭነው አመጡት፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ቀበሩት።

verses.en: Then all the people of Yehudah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ሕዝብ ሁሉ የአሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ የነበረውን ዖዝያንን ወስደው በአባቱ በአሜስያስ ፋንታ አነገሡት።

verses.en: He built Eloth, and restored it to Yehudah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ከአባቶቹ ጋር ከአንቀላፋ በኋላ ዖዝያን ኤላትን ሠራ፥ ወደ ይሁዳም መለሳት።

verses.en: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Jecoliah of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ዖዝያንም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የአሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አምሳ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ይኮልያ የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, according to all that his father Amaziah did.
verses.am: አባቱም አሜስያስ እንዳደረገው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.en: And he sought YAHUAH in the days of Zekaryah, who had understanding in the visions of YAHUAH: and as long as he sought YAHUAH, YAHUAH made him to prosper.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም መፍራት ባስተማረ በዘካርያስ ዘመን እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልግ ዘንድ ልብ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም በፈለገ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ነገሩን አከናወነለት።

verses.en: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
verses.am: ወጥቶም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ተዋጋ፥ የጌትንና የየብናን የአዞጦንንም ቅጥር አፈረሰ፤ በአዛጦንና በፍልስጥኤማውያንም አገር ከተሞችን ሠራ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal, and the Mehunims.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በፍልስጥኤማውያንና በጉርበኣል በሚኖሩ ዓረባውያን በምዑናውያንም ላይ ረዳው።

verses.en: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Mitsrayim; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.
verses.am: አሞናውያንም ለዖዝያን ገበሩ፤ እጅግም በርትቶ ነበርና ዝናው እስከ ግብጽ መግቢያ ድረስ ተሰማ።

verses.en: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Yerushalayim at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.
verses.am: ዖዝያንም በኢየሩሳሌም በማዕዘኑ በርና በሸለቆው በር ቅጥሩም በዞረበት ማዕዘን አጠገብ ግንቦችን ሠርቶ መሸጋቸው።

verses.en: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
verses.am: ብዙም እንስሶች ነበሩበትና በምድረ በዳና በቈላው በደጋውም ግንብ ሠራ፥ ብዙ ጕድጓድም ማሰ፤ ደግሞም እርሻ ይወድድ ነበርና በተራራማውና በፍሬያማው ስፍራ አራሾችና አትክልተኞች ነበሩት።

verses.en: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.
verses.am: ደግሞም ለዖዝያን በሠራዊት ውስጥ ሰልፈኞች ነበሩት፤ በንጉሡ አለቃ በሐናንያ ትእዛዝ በአለቃው በመዕሤያና በጸሐፊው በይዒኤል እጅ እንደ ተቈጠሩ ወደ ሰልፍ በየቍጥራቸው ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.en: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች የጽኑዓን ኃያላኑ ቍጥር ሁሉ ሁለት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበረ።

verses.en: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
verses.am: ንጉሡንም በጠላቱ ላይ ያግዝ ዘንድ፥ በታላቅ ኃይል ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጣ፥ ከእጃቸው በታች የነበረ ሠራዊት ሦስት መቶ ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.
verses.am: ዖዝያንም ለጭፍራው ሁሉ ጋሻና ጦር፥ ራስ ቍርና ጥሩር፥ ቀስትና የሚወነጭፉትን ድንጋይ አዘጋጀላቸው።

verses.en: And he made in Yerushalayim engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም በብልሃተኞች እጅ የተሠሩትን፥ በግንብና በቅጥር ላይ የሚኖሩትን፥ ፍላጻና መርግ የሚወረወርባቸውን መሣሪያዎች አደረገ፤ እስኪበረታም ድረስ እግዚአብሔር በድንቅ ረድቶታልና ዝናው እስከ ሩቅ ድረስ ተሰማ።

verses.en: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against YAHUAH his YAHUAH, and went into the temple of YAHUAH to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በበረታ ጊዜ ለጥፋት ልቡ ታበየ፥ አምላኩንም እግዚአብሔርን በደለ፤ ወደ መቅደስ ገብቶ በዕጣን መሠዊያ ላይ ዐጠነ።

verses.en: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of YAHUAH, that were valiant men:
verses.am: ካህኑም ዓዛርያስ ከእርሱም ጋር ጽኑዓን የነበሩ ሰማንያ የእግዚአብሔር ካህናት ተከትለው ገቡ።

verses.en: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto YAHUAH, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from YAHUAH.
verses.am: ንጉሡንም ዖዝያንን እየተቃወሙ። ዖዝያን ሆይ፥ ዕጣን ማጠን የተቀደሱት የአሮን ልጆች የካህናቱ ሹመት ነው እንጂ ለእግዚአብሔር ታጥን ዘንድ ለአንተ አይገባህም፤ በድለሃልና ከመቅደሱ ውጣ፤ ከአምላክህም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ክብር አይሆንልህም አሉት።

verses.en: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of YAHUAH, from beside the incense altar.
verses.am: ዖዝያንም ተቈጣ፤ የሚያጥንበትም ጥና በእጁ ነበረ፤ ካህናቱንም በተቈጣ ጊዜ በካህናቱ ፊት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በዕጣኑ መሠዊያ አጠገብ ሳለ በግምባሩ ላይ ለምጽ ታየ።

verses.en: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because YAHUAH had smitten him.
verses.am: ታላቁም ካህን ዓዛርያስ ካህናቱም ሁሉ ተመለከቱት፥ እነሆም፥ በግምባሩ ላይ ለምጽ ነበረ፤ ፈጥነውም አባርረሩት፥ እርሱም ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ቀሥፎት ነበርና ይወጣ ዘንድ ቸኰለ።

verses.en: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of YAHUAH: and Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዖዝያን እስኪሞት ድረስ ለምጻም ነበረ፤ ለምጻምም ሆኖ ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተቈርጦአልና በተለየ ቤት ይቀመጥ ነበር፤ ልጁም ኢዮአታም በንጉሡ ቤት ላይ ሆኖ በምድሩ ሕዝብ ላይ ይፈርድ ነበር።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Yeshayahu the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
verses.am: የቀረውንም የፊተኛውንና የኋለኛውን የዖዝያንን ነገር ነቢዩ የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ጽፎታል።

verses.en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: ዖዝያንም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ ለምጻም ነው ብለውም ከአባቶቹ ጋር በነገሥታቱ መቃብር እርሻ ውስጥ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም ኢዮአታም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim. His mother's name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.am: ኢዮአታምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የሳዶቅ ልጅ ኢየሩሳ ትባል ነበር።

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of YAHUAH. And the people did yet corruptly.
verses.am: አባቱም ዖዝያን እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅደስ አልገባም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና ይበድል ነበር።

verses.en: He built the high gate of the house of YAHUAH, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት የላይኛውን በር ሠራ፥ በዖፌልም ቅጥር ላይ እጅግ ሠራ።

verses.en: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Yehudah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
verses.am: በተራራማውም በይሁዳ አገር ላይ ከተሞችን ሠራ፥ በዱር ስፍራዎችም አምባዎችንና ግንቦችን ሠራ።

verses.en: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.
verses.am: ከአሞንም ልጆች ንጉሥ ጋር ተዋጋ አሸነፋቸውም። በዚያም ዓመት የአሞን ልጆች መቶ መክሊት ብር፥ አሥር ሺህም የቆሬስ መስፈሪያ ስንዴ፥ አሥር ሺህም የቆሬስ መሥፈሪያ ገብስ ሰጡት። እንዲሁም ደግሞ የአሞን ልጆች በሁለተኛውና በሦስተኛው ዓመት ሰጡት።

verses.en: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before YAHUAH his YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢዮአታምም በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መንገዱን አቅንቶአልና በረታ።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Yisra'el and Yehudah.
verses.am: የቀረውም የኢዮአታም ነገር፥ ሰልፉም ሁሉ፥ ሥራውም፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.am: ኢዮአታምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም አካዝ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim: but he did not that which was right in the sight of YAHUAH, like Dawid his father:
verses.am: አካዝ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እንደ አባቱም እንደ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አላደረገም።

verses.en: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Yisra'el, and made also molten images for Baalim.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፥ ደግሞም ለበኣሊም ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎችን ሠራ።

verses.en: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom YAHUAH had cast out before the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ደግሞም በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ዐጠነ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳሳደዳቸው እንደ አሕዛብም ክፉ ልማድ ልጆቹን በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.en: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.am: በኮረብታው መስገጃዎችና በተራሮች ላይ በለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore YAHUAH his YAHUAH delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Yisra'el, who smote him with a great slaughter.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር በሶርያ ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ ሶርያውያንም መቱት፥ ከእርሱም ብዙ ምርኮኞች ወስደው ወደ ደማስቆ አመጡ። ደግሞም በእስራኤል ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ እርሱም በታላቅ አመታት መታው።

verses.en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Yehudah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken YAHUAH of their fathers.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ነበርና የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ በአንድ ቀን ከይሁዳ መቶ ሀያ ሺህ ገደለ፤ ሁሉም ጽኑዓን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
verses.am: ከኤፍሬምም ወገን የነበረው ኃያል ሰው ዝክሪ የንጉሡን ልጅ መዕሤያንና የቤቱን አዛዥ ዓዝሪቃምን፥ ለንጉሡም በማዕርግ ሁለተኛ የሆነውን ሕልቃናን ገደለ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከወንድሞቻቸው ሁለት መቶ ሺህ ሴቶችን፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ማረኩ፥ እጅግም ምርኮ ከእነርሱ ወስደው ወደ ሰማርያ አገቡ።

verses.en: But a prophet of YAHUAH was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because YAHUAH of your fathers was wroth with Yehudah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.
verses.am: በዚያም ዖዴድ የተባለ የእግዚአብሔር ነቢይ ነበረ፤ ወደ ሰማርያም የሚመጣውን ጭፍራ ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይሁዳን ስለ ተቈጣ በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ እናንተም ወደ ሰማይ በሚደርስ ቍጣ ገደላችኋቸው።

verses.en: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Yehudah and Yerushalayim for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against YAHUAH your YAHUAH?
verses.am: አሁንም የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌም ልጆች ባሪያዎች ሆነው ይገዙላችሁ ዘንድ ታስባላችሁ፤ ነገር ግን አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን የበደላችሁት በደል በእናንተ ዘንድ የለምን?

verses.en: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of YAHUAH is upon you.
verses.am: አሁንም ስሙኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በላያችሁ ነድዶአልና ከወንድሞቻችሁ የወሰዳችኋቸውን ምርኮኞች መልሱ።
